name: little-joan
description: A tiny pop-up browser that hibernates until a global shortcut calls it.
author: Mehmet Ali Ertorer

scripts.icons: node scripts/make-icons.mts && tauri icon .cache/icons/app-icon.png -o .cache/icons/generated && node scripts/copy-icons.mts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build:ui && npm run rust:fmt && npm run rust:clippy && npm run rust:test
